svg.title: With Claude Haiku 5.5, long packets are harder, clearly so for holistic; with Claude Haiku 5.5, holistic's lead on long packets is unclear
svg.desc: Page by page, 5–20 pages: mean 0.68. Holistic, 5–20 pages: mean 0.76. Page by page, 30–60 pages: mean 0.62. Holistic, 30–60 pages: mean 0.62. 5–20 pages: holistic minus page by page +0.08 ± 0.05; holistic better on 50, tie 28, worse 22. 30–60 pages: holistic minus page by page 0.00 ± 0.06; holistic better on 16, tie 1, worse 23.

Boxes: middle half of the packets, line at the median. Whiskers: 5th to 95th percentile. Dots: the mean, with a bar of ±2 standard errors.
